data.name: Pitch Black Bunkers and Caves
data.shortDescription: Removes most light sources from Bunkers and Caves to enhance horror.
data.description:
Sons of the forest is a horror game, but some indoor locations are too handholdy with the amount of light they give you. This mod fixes that by removing light sources from caves and bunkers allowing for a much scarier experience. 

*Also this mod is heavily configurable so if saw you only want this to effect a specific cave or bunker you can handle that in the mod configs.

What this mod DOES remove or edit:

1. Most light sources.
2. Indoor Audio in Bunkers has been replaced with cave music.
3. Most glowing textures.
4. Welcome Back announcers have been shut off to give the bunkers an abandoned facility vibe.
5. Video playing monitors that are apart of background detail have either been hidden or their video frozen.

Exceptions and what this mod does not remove or darken:

1. Player made structure light sources like torches.
2. Particle effects 
3. 3D printer lights.
4. Radios. I left these alone since they drop microchips and are used for building things.
5. Some monitors are dimmed instead of switched off.
6. Mission critical computer screen exclamation lights.
7. Cutscenes are unaffected. 
8. Has no effect on glowing enemies or enemies with light sources.
9. Only affects instanced indoor locations. Not the overworld caves.

Multiplayer:

This mod is client sided sided. Works as both the host and client, but changes made will only appear for person using the mod. Coordinate with the host and client(s) to have matching settings.

versions.changelog: Fixed a wall being improperly hidden in the Entertainment Bunker. Its now visible, but darkened.
